reviewer: Isolated reviewer plus trusted cycle compiler/behavior gates

functions.reason: An independent MSVC 2013 build with /O2 /Oy- /arch:SSE2 produced a complete, relocation-free 46-byte code section identical to the bytes extracted from Game.exe. The instructions confirm the ECX/stack argument convention, XMM0 result, arithmetic order, and callee stack cleanup. The submitted 272-case test passed when independently linked against both the compiled section and bytes extracted directly from the original, with SSE enabled; it checks edge values, aliasing, and unchanged input and guard bytes. The routine has no conditional branches. The test samples only the low result lane and default floating-point environment, so it does not establish exhaustive behavioral coverage, but the full instruction-byte match independently supports equivalence for this fragment.

limits: Complete native compiler fragment and byte-checked reference tested at relocated addresses
Sampled tests independently reviewed for the specific routine; not all-input equivalence or a full game run
Original 32-bit ABI; external calls/relocations require a separate qualified recipe
